title: Milan · Stelvio and Gavia Serious Pass Day
slogan: Hairpin mythology with no room for fantasy planning.
story: Hairpin mythology with no room for fantasy planning. 374 km round from Bormio - plan on about 7 h 12 of riding. It goes by way of Santa Maria and Tirano. The climbs: Stelvio Pass and Gavia Pass. It tops out at about 2,750 m. Stelvio Pass and Gavia Pass are open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. It crosses from Italy into Switzerland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It is a high-mountain day.
hero: Milan · Stelvio and Gavia Serious Pass Day

title: Milan · Ligurian Apennines and Portofino
slogan: A 310 km loop out of Pavia
story: Mountain switchbacks with a sea-air finish. A 304 km loop that starts and ends near Pavia, about 5 h 51 of riding. It goes by way of Bobbio Trebbia road and Portofino coast. The climb of the day is Passo del Penice. It is a high-mountain day.
